{{Top|leg}}
'''Dactyl ammonia crystals''' were supplements that [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] were constantly required to take when away from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Cona/Legends|Cona]]. Since all of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] Arcona eat on their homeworld contained traces of [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] due to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], dactyl ammonia crystals were required to help them rid their bodies of waste materials.<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
